# Project Requirements Checklist

| # | Requirement | Human outcome | Source / owner | State | Evidence | Next action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | <requirement> | <what the person can actually do> | <ref> | PASS / FAIL / WAIT / UNKNOWN / N_A_WITH_EVIDENCE | <ref> | <action> |

## Gate
- UNKNOWN blocks completion.
- A requirement is not PASS because code, a prompt, a comment, or a template exists.
- Human-facing requirements require a human-usable surface or explicit N/A evidence.
- Re-run this checklist after any affected primitive, requirement, source, runtime, or UX contract changes.
